description: rekal deterministic memory: inject real recall on session start + each turn, auto-persist before compaction and at session end, and redirect file-based memory to rekal. The env lives in ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/venv (survives plugin updates); SessionStart syncs it only when uv.lock changed, every other hook runs --no-sync so the hot path never resolves or touches the network.

hooks.command: { diff -q "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/uv.lock" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/uv.lock" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/venv" uv sync --frozen --quiet --project "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" && cp "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/uv.lock" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/uv.lock"; } || { rm -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/uv.lock"; exit 0; }; } && UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/venv" uv run --frozen --no-sync --project "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" rekal hook session-start

hooks.prompt: Context is about to be compacted, so run the rekal-save procedure now before anything is lost: extract durable facts, decisions, and preferences from the transcript, dedupe each via mcp__rekal__memory_build_context then mcp__rekal__memory_store (pass replaces=<old_id> when a memory on the same topic exists; never two memories on one topic, never store secrets), and produce no user-facing output. Transcript: $ARGUMENTS

hooks.statusMessage: rekal: persisting memory at session end
hooks.prompt: The session is ending, so run the rekal-save procedure now before anything is lost: extract durable facts, decisions, and preferences from the transcript, dedupe each via mcp__rekal__memory_build_context then mcp__rekal__memory_store (pass replaces=<old_id> when a memory on the same topic exists; never two memories on one topic, never store secrets), and produce no user-facing output. Transcript: $ARGUMENTS
